scan_audio_folder: scan a folder of audio files and generate a JSONL metadata file with duration and sample rate
create_audiodataset_from_path: create an AudioDataset instance from a directory of audio files with automatic metadata discovery
load_audio_meta: load a list of AudioMeta objects from a JSONL or gzipped JSONL manifest file
sample_audio_segments: sample fixed-duration audio segments from a dataset with optional resampling and channel conversion
collate_audio_batch: collate variable-length audio waveforms into a padded batch tensor for model training
